run_configure: run the configure script to set up Bazel build parameters for reverb with default python paths
setup_python: setup python binary and library paths for reverb Bazel build configuration
get_python_path: get python site package paths from environment or by running python introspection commands
reset_configure_bazelrc: reset the .reverb.bazelrc file to clear previous custom build configuration settings
write_to_bazelrc: append a build configuration line to the .reverb.bazelrc file for Bazel settings
